title: Appraisal Order Report Type Eligibility Matrix
content:
Each Appraisal Order report type is accepted only for the loan files its form covers. The matrix below states, for every report type in the Larkspur appraisal line, how the appraiser observes the property, the loan programs for which the report is accepted, the property types the form covers, the loan purposes for which it is accepted, the most dwelling units it covers and the highest base-loan-to-value at which it is accepted. Loan program names in the matrix are the official Larkspur program names, each preceded by "Larkspur" (for example, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed).

## Inspection scope and program acceptance

| Report type | Inspection scope | Loan programs accepted (Larkspur ...) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | Desktop (no visit) | HomeReady 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 15-Year Fixed; High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | Exterior (drive-by) | HomeReady 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 15-Year Fixed; High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | Interior (full walk-through) | FHA 30-Year Fixed; VA 30-Year Fixed; HomeReady 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 15-Year Fixed; High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed; Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | Interior (full walk-through) | VA 30-Year Fixed; HomeReady 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 15-Year Fixed; High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed; Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | Interior (full walk-through) | FHA 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | Interior (full walk-through) | FHA 30-Year Fixed; VA 30-Year Fixed; HomeReady 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 30-Year Fixed; Conventional 15-Year Fixed; High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed; Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | Interior (full walk-through) | High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed; Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |

## Property, purpose and size limits

| Report type | Property types covered | Loan purposes accepted | Maximum dwelling units | Maximum base-loan-to-value (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | single-family detached; townhouse | purchase | 1 | 90.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | single-family detached; townhouse | purchase; rate-and-term refinance | 1 | 80.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | condominium | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | 1 | 97.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | single-family detached; townhouse; manufactured home | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | 1 | 100.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | single-family detached; townhouse; manufactured home | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | 1 | 96.50 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | two-to-four-unit | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | 4 | 95.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | single-family detached; townhouse; condominium | purchase; rate-and-term refinance; cash-out refinance | 1 | 85.00 |

## Reading the matrix

- **Inspection scope** describes how the property is observed: a desktop report involves no visit, an exterior-only report is a drive-by, and an interior report is a full walk-through.
- **Maximum dwelling units** is a whole number; the Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) is the only report type that covers more than one unit, up to 4.
- **Maximum base-loan-to-value** is a percentage stated to two decimals; a file at exactly the figure shown is within it, and a file above it is not.
- Only the Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) is limited to purchases alone; the Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) is accepted only for the Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, and the Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) only for the Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed and the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed.

### Illustration (hypothetical file)

A hypothetical purchase of a one-unit condominium under the Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed at a base-loan-to-value of 96.00 percent: the Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) lists that program, covers condominiums and purchases, covers 1 unit and accepts up to 97.00 percent, so the form fits; the Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) does not, because that program is not among its accepted programs.
